link.note: Second wife of William Wells and mother of Mehitable; her surname is unknown. The tree's 'Youngs' maiden name and descent from Rev. John Youngs are rejected by Hayes (1878) and Youngs (1907).

death.place: Southold, Suffolk, New York, United States

summary: John's 10th-great-grandmother; William Wells's second wife, later Mrs. Mapes; maiden name unknown.
bio: Hayes (1878, pp. 27–28): Wells married about 1654 'Mary… whose family name is said to be Youngs', adding 'Thus far I have found nothing to throw any light on the question'; she 'can hardly have been' Rev. John Youngs's sister (who married William Browne of Salem), nor his daughter Mary (b. 1631) who 'more prob. m. Edward Petty'. Her own will of 26 Dec 1678, as 'Mary Mapes … relict of William Wells', names 'my son-in-law John Youngs, in right of his wife … Mary Youngs, his wife, my daughter' — the Youngs connection came through a daughter, not the mother (as Hayes guessed). Tree: 'Mary Maria YOUNGS 1619–1709', father 'John E M o Yonges' 1598–1671.
sources: Southold Town Records v1; WikiTree Wells-639
